title: Senior AI Product Manager
jd_excerpt:
Position: AI Product Manager

Location: Dallas, TX

Duration: Long Term

About R Systems:

R Systems is a leading digital product engineering company that designs and develops chip-to-cloud software products, platforms, and digital experiences that empower its clients to achieve higher revenues and operational efficiency. Our product mindset and engineering capabilities in Cloud, Data, AI, and CX enable us to serve key players in the high-tech industry, including ISVs, SaaS, and Internet companies, as well as product companies in telecom, media, finance, manufacturing, and health verticals. We are Great Place to Work Certified in 10 countries with a full-time workforce [India, USA, Canada, Poland, Romania, Moldova, Indonesia, Singapore, Malaysia & Thailand]! We are recognized as one of the Best Tech Brands 2024 by the Times Group and India's Top 500 Value Creators 2023 by Dun & Bradstreet.

Job Description:

We are seeking an experienced and innovative AI Product Manager to lead the strategy, development, and launch of AI-powered products and solutions. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and enterprise product management.

The AI Product Manager will work closely with engineering, data science, UX/UI, business stakeholders, and leadership teams to identify AI-driven opportunities, define product roadmaps, and deliver scalable, customer-focused AI solutions.

The ideal candidate should possess a combination of technical knowledge, business acumen, strategic thinking, and excellent communication skills to translate complex AI capabilities into impactful business products.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Product Strategy & Roadmap
• Define and execute the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for AI-powered products and platforms.
• Identify business opportunities where AI and automation can deliver measurable value.
• Translate business requirements and customer needs into product features and capabilities.
• Prioritize product initiatives based on business impact, technical feasibility, and customer value.
• Define product KPIs, success metrics, and ROI measurements.

2. AI & Generative AI Product Development
• Lead the development and deployment of AI/ML-powered products and solutions.
• Drive product initiatives involving Generative AI, LLMs, NLP, computer vision, and predictive analytics.
• Collaborate with engineering teams to build AI-powered applications using technologies such as OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, and Google Vertex AI.
• Define requirements for AI agents, intelligent automation, chatbots, copilots, and enterprise AI solutions.
• Understand model capabilities, limitations, performance, accuracy, and scalability.

3. Cross-Functional Collaboration
• Work closely with data scientists, AI/ML engineers, software developers, architects, and UX/UI designers.
• Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into actionable product specifications.
• Lead product discovery sessions, sprint planning, backlog prioritization, and product reviews.
• Communicate product vision, priorities, and progress to executive leadership and stakeholders.

4. Product Lifecycle Management
• Manage the complete product lifecycle, from ideation and discovery to development, launch, and continuous improvement.
• Create product requirement documents (PRDs), user stories, acceptance criteria, and product roadmaps.
• Define MVP scope and oversee iterative product releases.
• Monitor product adoption, user engagement, and performance.
• Gather customer feedback and continuously enhance product functionality.

5. Responsible AI & Governance
• Ensure AI solutions align with responsible AI principles and organizational policies.
• Partner with security, legal, compliance, and risk teams to address AI governance requirements.
• Address data privacy, model bias, explainability, security, and ethical AI considerations.
• Establish processes for monitoring AI model performance and reliability.

Required Skills & Qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, or a related field.
• 5+ years of experience in Product Management, preferably with AI/ML or technology products.
• Demonstrated experience managing AI-powered products or platforms.
• Strong understanding of Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Generative AI.
• Hands-on familiarity with Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
• Understanding of AI agents, copilots, conversational AI, and intelligent automation.
• Experience working with Agile/Scrum methodologies.
• Strong experience creating PRDs, user stories, product roadmaps, and product strategy documents.
• Ability to work with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Excellent analytical, problem-solving, leadership, and communication skills.

Why Join R Systems?
• Frequent Internal Hackathons: Engage in dynamic competitions with exciting prizes to keep your skills sharp.
• Cultural Celebrations: Strengthen our familial bonds through shared celebrations, fostering a sense of community.
• Diverse Project Exposure: Work on a variety of projects across sectors like Healthcare, Banking, e-commerce, and Retail, collaborating with leading global brands.
• Centre of Excellence (COE): Benefit from technical guidance and upskilling opportunities provided by our team of technology experts, helping you navigate your career path.
• E-Learning Platform: Gain access to comprehensive e-learning platforms coupled with a robust mentorship program to enhance your skills.
• Open Door Policy: Embrace a culture of mutual support, respect, and open dialogue, promoting a collaborative work environment.

If you are passionate and excited about working in a fast-paced, innovative environment, we would love to hear from you!

R Systems is an equal opportunity employ
